say:3:1120325001:1.text: My, that was fast! Let me see...
say:3:1120325001:1.source_cn: 竟然这么快就把蜘蛛蛋带回来了。让我看看……

say:4:1120325002:1.text: Yes, these are exactly the ones I wanted! The shape, the color, and that incomparably delicious aroma!
say:4:1120325002:1.source_cn: 没错，我想要的就是这个！这种绝妙的色泽，完美的形状，还...

say:5:1120325003:1.text: Ahh, my mouth is already starting to water!
say:5:1120325003:1.source_cn: 我的口水都要掉下来了！

say:6:1120325004:1.text: Are we... talking about the same spider eggs here?
say:6:1120325004:1.source_cn: 这……难道我们和狐獴们看到的不是同一个蜘蛛蛋吗……

say:7:1120325005:1.text: I may not understand it... But we should respect their tastes all the same.
say:7:1120325005:1.source_cn: 虽然我也不理解……但姑且尊重口味的多样性吧。

say:8:1120325006:1.text: Your generous payment has been received with the utmost gratitude, my friends!
say:8:1120325006:1.source_cn: 好嘞，报酬我已经都收好了。真的太感谢各位了！

say:9:1120325007:1.text: We should be the ones thanking you... You've been such a huge help, Smokey!
say:9:1120325007:1.source_cn: 不不不，应该是我们谢你才对……谢谢你帮了我们！

say:10:1120325008:1.text: Ah, think nothing of it! Feel free to call on me if you ever need my services again!
say:10:1120325008:1.source_cn: 嗨呀，这些都是小事。如果你们下次还有什么要帮忙的，随时...

say:11:1120325009:1.text: Naturally, I will gladly accept spider eggs as compensation!
say:11:1120325009:1.source_cn: 当然，报酬还可以是蜘蛛蛋！

choice_prompt:12:1120325009.text: Naturally, I will gladly accept spider eggs as compensation!
choice_prompt:12:1120325009.source_cn: 当然，报酬还可以是蜘蛛蛋！

say:13:1120325010:1.text: Hahaha! It's getting late, so I must be going now.
say:13:1120325010:1.source_cn: 哈哈，时候不早了，我也差不多该准备离开了。

say:14:1120325011:1.text: That reminds me that you may keep the rest of that potion for yourselves.
say:14:1120325011:1.source_cn: 对了，这瓶药剂，是送给你们的。

say:15:1120325012:1.text: Wait... Isn't this the exact same potion as before?
say:15:1120325012:1.source_cn: 这个是……和之前一样的那种药剂？

say:16:1120325013:1.text: Indeed it is! This potion is useful for treating a variety of basic poisons. You may find use for it later in your travels.
say:16:1120325013:1.source_cn: 嗯，这种药剂可以治疗一些基础的中毒。你们留着以备不时之需吧。

say:17:1120325014:1.text: It must be really valuable. Are you sure you want us to keep it?
say:17:1120325014:1.source_cn: 这个很贵重吧？真的可以送给我们吗？

say:18:1120325015:1.text: You've already done so much for us... It almost feels wrong to accept it after all your help...
say:18:1120325015:1.source_cn: 你帮了我们这么多，还送东西……感觉不太好意思收来着……

say:19:1120325016:1.text: It's fine! Consider it a parting gift!
say:19:1120325016:1.source_cn: 没事，就当是我给你们的送别礼吧。

say:20:1120325017:1.text: However, if you want me to concoct even more unique potions, you'll have to bring me more food. How do scorpions sound to you?
say:20:1120325017:1.source_cn: 不过如果你们还想要更特别的药剂，之后就要用别的东西来换...

say:23:1120325018:1.text: S-S-S-Scorpions?! Do meerkats really eat something that dangerous?!
say:23:1120325018:1.source_cn: 蝎、蝎、蝎子！你们狐獴吃的东西也太奇怪了吧，竟然还吃蝎子！

say:24:1120325019:1.text: They may be dangerous to you, but scorpion venom poses very little threat to us! Their flavorful meat makes them a delicacy on par with spider eggs!
say:24:1120325019:1.source_cn: 对我们狐獴来说，蝎子可一点毒素都没有，反而味道鲜美，就...

choice_prompt:25:1120325019.text: They may be dangerous to you, but scorpion venom poses very little threat to us! Their flavorful meat makes them a delicacy on par with spider eggs!
choice_prompt:25:1120325019.source_cn: 对我们狐獴来说，蝎子可一点毒素都没有，反而味道鲜美，就和蜘蛛蛋一样，是一道美味佳肴哦。

say:26:1120325020:1.text: No kidding! Just thinking about eating this sort of stuff makes me feel sick...
say:26:1120325020:1.source_cn: 没错！光是想象自己要吃这种东西，我就已经不舒服起来了……

say:27:1120325021:1.text: You're welcome to try our cuisine for yourselves someday! I'll even prepare them without poison, just for you!
say:27:1120325021:1.source_cn: 以后有机会的话，你们可以尝尝看，我给你们做个无毒版本的！

say:31:1120325023:1.text: Ah, what a shame! Until next time, my friends!
say:31:1120325023:1.source_cn: 真是可惜！那么我就先走了，各位，有缘再见了！

choice:25:0:1.source_cn: 你们狐獴的菜单还真是丰富……

choice:25:1:2.text: Are all meerkat foods this terrifying...?
choice:25:1:2.source_cn: 你们狐獴的菜单还真是可怕……
choice:25:1:2.male: Are all meerkat foods this terrifying...?
choice:25:1:2.female: Are all meerkat foods this terrifying...?

choice:12:0:1.text: I think we're okay for now.
choice:12:0:1.male: I think we're okay for now.
choice:12:0:1.female: I think we're okay for now.

choice:12:1:2.text: I don't want to fight spiders again.
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 最近都不想再去打蜘蛛了
choice:12:1:2.male: I don't want to fight spiders again.
choice:12:1:2.female: I don't want to fight spiders again.
